title: Emergence of Thermodynamics from Equilibration in Isolated Quantum Systems
summary: Understanding how macroscopic thermodynamic behavior emerges from microscopic quantum dynamics remains an open problem. While equilibration of quantum observables is well established, thermodynamics also relies on variables not directly associated with linear operators, but which are defined instead as functions of expectation values. Whether and how such derived quantities inherit equilibration properties is an open question.
